name: Tilskudd til naturrestaurering
summary: Annual Norwegian grant for planning, carrying out and following up restoration of degraded nature outside protected areas, open to organisations, municipalities and private project owners. Applications must be at least NOK 100,000 and need a signed landowner agreement.

amount.note: Minimum application amount for a restoration measure.

reporting: Grant recipients report on how the funds were used, how the measures were carried out and the results, in the application centre, with signed accounts attached.
